reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a camera enclosed by two circular sync/rotate arrows. While originating as a mobile UI glyph for flipping between front and rear cameras, in a task manager it serves well for photo backup/syncing, rotating images, switching webcams, or trading in camera gear. It must be distinguished from a plain camera icon (taking photos) and generic sync arrows (non-photo backups).
